title: ci(release): stop predicting changesets/action's branch, and re-home the @v1 ref pin
body:
Fixes #6081

Deletes the `lane` job's bash mirror of `changesets/action`'s file scan and the
`pending_changesets` prediction it fed, per the PM ruling (option 3 / option A) on the
measurement round. The clear step's guard becomes `if: github.event_name == 'push'`.

Union gate run and all evidence below are from **`b69e157fe`**, the final commit on this
branch. Base re-derived at claim: `7797e3b74` (three commits had landed since the
measurement round's `f0880161b`).

## Why the mirror went rather than getting a better referent

The mirror predicted which branch `changesets/action` would take, and the thing it
mirrored has no stable referent: the action is used at a **moving tag**, its bundled
`@changesets/read@^0.6.7` is a different major from the `1.0.0` this repo installs, the
two disagree in **opposite** directions, and the bundle is a minified chunk nothing here
installs — so no test could execute it and no lockfile recorded it. A retag of `v1` in
place changed the mirror's referent and nothing in this repository failed.

The prediction was deletable because the step it gated is idempotent and a measured
no-op on an empty tree. Option 1 (SHA pin) keeps the copy; option 2 keeps the hole.
Sequencing behind `changesets/action@v2` was rejected because that migration was
declined twice in five days (objectstack#9208 2026-08-19, objectui#4945 2026-08-23) and
its API-based push would invalidate the property the clear step's safety rests on.

## The two non-negotiables

### 1. The event test STAYS

The guard drops only the prediction half:

```yaml
- name: Clear pending changesets for the publish branch
  if: github.event_name == 'push'
```

Dropping `github.event_name == 'push'` as well would kill the release **silently**: on
the refresh lane this step would empty the tree before the action runs, so
`hasChangesets` is false, and that lane passes no `publish:` input so `hasPublishScript`
is false too. v1 then takes `case !hasChangesets && !hasPublishScript` (`src/index.ts`
line 68), logs "No changesets present or were removed by merging release PR" and
returns — a permanent no-op refresh and a fossilised version PR. That reasoning is now
written at the guard itself, not only here.

### 2. The `changesets/action@v1` ref pin is re-homed, not deleted

`changeset-release-lane-mirror.test.ts:279` was the **only** mechanical pin on that ref
anywhere in the repository, and it guards the dispatch table the clear step still
depends on after the mirror is gone. It now lives in
`scripts/__tests__/changeset-release-action-ref-pin.test.ts`, whose subject is the ref
itself, so no future cleanup of something else can take it along by accident.

Re-homed **stronger** than it was: the old assertion was
`expect(uses).toContain('changesets/action@v1')` over one job, which passes if one of
the two `uses:` lines is bumped and the other is not. The new one matches on the action
**repository** (so `changesets/action/publish@v2`, the shape a real v2 migration takes,
is caught rather than silently not-found), requires **every** usage to be `@v1`, and
asserts both usages are still present so a dropped lane is caught too.

## Verification

### Both branches of the clear step, under the new guard

Script **extracted** from the workflow (`jobs.release.steps[].run`), never transcribed,
run over fixtures. Case B is the decisive one — the branch the deleted guard used to
skip, which now runs:

| case | tree before | run 1 | run 2 (idempotency) | tree after |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A — pending present | `AGENTS.md`, 2 changesets, `README.md`, `config.json` | exit 0, `Removed 3` | exit 0, `Removed 0` | `README.md`, `config.json` |
| **B — nothing pending** (was skipped) | `README.md`, `config.json` | exit 0, `Removed 0` | exit 0, `Removed 0` | **unchanged** |
| C — no `.changeset/` at all | empty | exit 0, `Removed 0` | exit 0, `Removed 0` | empty |
| D — pre mode, consumed ids | + `pre.json`, 2 consumed | exit 0, `Removed 2` | exit 0, `Removed 0` | `pre.json` survives |

### ⚠️ The one non-no-op divergence, recorded as dormant-but-real

**Case D** is the only input on which "run unconditionally" is not literally a no-op. In
pre mode, ids already listed in `pre.json.changesets` are consumed records that the
deleted mirror filtered out and this step does not, so it removes them (`Removed 2`)
while **`pre.json` itself survives**, so pre mode is still detected.

Harmless on three independent grounds: the deletion is runner-local (`runPublish` only
calls `git.pushTag`, `src/run.ts:124,146`; `prepareBranch`/`pushChanges` are
`runVersion`-only at `:290,:362`); the next `changeset version` deletes those records
anyway; and **this repository has no `pre.json` and no `.changeset/pre/` directory
today**. It is dormant, not absent — a future pre-release would meet it. Named here and
in a `⚠️` block at the step, because a pre-release is exactly when nobody wants to
rediscover it.

### The re-homed pin's red/green pair

Proven **both before and after** the mirror test's deletion, each mutation confirmed on
disk by grepping the injected and deleted text (not by an editor's exit code), with a
`trap ... EXIT INT TERM` restore leg:

| | green (real workflow) | red (`uses:` bumped to `@v2` on disk) |
|---|---|---|
| before deletion | `Tests 7 passed (7)` | `Tests 4 failed \| 3 passed (7)` |
| after deletion | `Tests 7 passed (7)` | `Tests 4 failed \| 3 passed (7)` |

The load-bearing failure is `pins EVERY usage`. The other three are the pin's own
non-vacuity block correctly refusing to run a mutation that no longer applies to an
already-mutated file. Restore verified: `git status` clean, `uses: changesets/action@v1`
back at 3 occurrences on disk.

### `pending_changesets` has no remaining reader

Re-run at the final tree across **both** repositories, since main had moved:

- **objectui** `b69e157fe`: 4 hits, **all prose** — two workflow comments explaining the
  removal, two changeset markdown lines. A grep for the output inside a `${{ }}`
  expression returns exit 1, no match. Surviving `needs.lane.outputs` references are
  `version_on_npm` (line 433) and `manifest_version` (line 811) only.
- **objectstack** `origin/main` `7adcd0769`: `git grep` **exit 1, zero matches**.

### Gates, each quoting its own verdict line, exit captured before any pipe

Union re-run at `b69e157fe`:

- Root vitest, `scripts/__tests__/` — `Test Files 70 passed (70)`, `Tests 1900 passed (1900)`;
  wrapper `VERDICT command-exit 0`
- `tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json` — `exit=0`, no diagnostics. The new test file **is** in
  that project (verified by resolving `parsed.fileNames`, not assumed)
- `check-control-bytes` — `exit=0`, verdict: ✅ check-control-bytes: OK (scanned 5099
  tracked text file(s); skipped 85 binary) — plus an independent scan of my changed
  files for raw control bytes (no hits)
- `check-changeset-presence` — `exit=0`, verdict: ✅ No source of a released package
  changed in this range, so no changeset is owed
- `check-changeset-no-major` — `exit=0`, verdict: ✅ No changeset declares a major bump
- `check-changeset-fixed` — `exit=0`, verdict: ✅ All workspace packages are in the
  changeset fixed group
- `check-entry-guard` — `exit=0`, verdict: ✓ check:entry-guard: 42 scripts/ file(s) — no
  entry guard outside the baseline

**Lint narrowing, declared.** Ran eslint on the changed paths rather than the repo:
(1) the population comes from eslint's own config, which reports
`.github/workflows/changeset-release.yml` and the changeset `.md` as *"File ignored
because no matching configuration was supplied"* — so the lintable population of this
diff is exactly one file; (2) `--format json` reports 1 configured file, **0 errors 0
warnings**; (3) type-aware linting is **not** enabled (no `project` / `projectService`
in `eslint.config.js`), so this diff cannot move the verdict on any untouched file. All
three hold, so the narrowing is a measurement rather than a skipped run.

## Notes

- **`.changeset` stays in the lane job's `sparse-checkout`** — the `npm` step reads
  `.changeset/config.json` for the `fixed` group. Only the changeset *files* stopped
  being read. Called out in the workflow so the next reader does not prune it as dead.
- The changeset is an **empty-frontmatter** declaration: no changeset is owed for a
  CI-only diff (the gate says so above), but it is how this repository records a change
  that publishes nothing, and it supersedes `5775-lane-changeset-reader-mirror.md`,
  which names the deleted test file. #5775's own changeset is left untouched — it was
  true of what that PR did, and rewriting another change's declaration is not this
  card's business.
